Instagram/Facebook confirm the business is open at 1597 E Vista Way Unit B (matches batch address) and reopened around Nov 2025 after a hiatus, but neither posts a price list. name: Seacoast Beach Bar & Sports Grill
notes: Batch website seacoastbeachbar.com 301-redirects to fangwin88play.com, a gambling-branded domain unrelated to food -- domain hijack, do not use. Uber Eats store page address (710 Seacoast Drive, F, Imperial Beach, CA 91932) matches the batch address exactly; catalogSectionsMap payload (decoded via %5C\u0022/\u0022 unescaping) gave 45 dishes across 11 sections (Shareables, Tacos, Aguachiles & Ceviche, Salads, Sides & Adds, Surf, Turf, Kid's, Dessert, Beverages, Breakfast), deduped on name+price, prices mostly .95-ending -- printed-menu pattern, no markup signature. Note: a June 2026 news report (whatnow.com) says the county ordered this location closed for food-code violations; the live, priced Uber Eats listing is more current evidence of trading than that report alone, so filed rather than blocked/not_found. Yelp/MapQuest 'CLOSED' tags are stale relative to the live marketplace page.

name: Jan's Health Bar
notes: Batch's Popmenu router hit a different branch (501 Main St # D) than our address (3722 Paseo Pl Ste 1440, San Diego, CA 92130 -- Del Mar Highlands Town Center). Used the restaurant's own-site PDF menu (first-party, single page) instead: 27 priced dishes across Sandwiches & Wraps, Salads & Bowls, Classic/Protein Smoothies, Acai Bowls, and Fresh Start/Soups & Sides. One item, 'Poppy Smoothie', described but has no price on the PDF and was dropped. The PDF appears to cut off after 'Customer Favorites' header with no items listed under it, and the multi-location Popmenu's section-name list additionally references Bottled Juices, Grab and Go, and Frozen Treat sections not present on this PDF -- those adjunct sections are omitted/undisclosed-priced; core sandwich/salad/smoothie/bowl menu is complete and priced.

name: Pahua's Bakery & Pizza

No markup-divisor signature found (DoorDash-native listing, not a marketplace-inflated capture), so prices used as-is.

name: Sarah's Dessert Bar
notes: Live site is currently unreachable (matches the batch router's own connect-timeout finding). Recovered the own-site 'Dessert Menu / Price List' via a Wayback Machine snapshot from 2025-09-06 (address on the page matches batch exactly: 880 Front St, San Diego, CA 92101). 12 priced items captured, including 3 quantity variants of macarons. Six additional items (Ube Cookies & Cream Mousse Cup, Cookies & Cream Mousse Cup, Tiramisu Cup, Panna Cotta Cup, Mango Caramel Cream Cup, Chocolate Peanut Butter Mousse Cup) were explicitly listed under a 'Coming Soon' heading with prices but marked as not yet available on the Available Now menu -- excluded as not currently orderable. Confidence set to medium rather than high because the source is an archived snapshot (prices may have changed since); flagging for re-check once the live site recovers.

name: Koakai Brewing Co.
notes: No independent website (router had none). Koakai Brewing Co. shares its address and food program with Kyoto Japanese Market next door (559 Greenbrier Drive, B1-B2, Oceanside -- confirmed matching batch address); food for both businesses is served from one shared kitchen via Kyoto Market's own Toast online-ordering page. Captured full priced menu: 138 items across Barbecue/Hot Food (plates, bowls, burgers/sandos, musubi, by-the-pound meats, sides), Sushi (rolls, nigiri, sashimi, poke, hand rolls, inari), and Market Food (bento boxes, sandos). Several items are marked OUT OF STOCK on the live page but retain listed prices -- kept in the list since they're temporarily 86'd, not removed menu items. First-party Toast ordering platform, no markup applied.
